title: Mealy transducer run
statement: Given sets $A$ and $\Gamma$ and a transition function $\delta:A\times\Gamma\to A\times\Gamma$, define the run on an initial state and a finite input list recursively. On the empty list it returns the initial state and the empty output list; on a nonempty list it applies $\delta$ to the current state and first symbol, then runs on the remaining list from the resulting state, returning the final state and the list of emitted symbols in their original order.
hypotheses_covered: A transition function from a state and symbol to a new state and symbol
An initial state and a finite input list
